_about: One record per guide video of the community section (社群攻略): creator, the co-authors (`with`: those the video description names, and the account that posted the summary picture), title, address, publication and reading dates, the game version its tags name, the server the creator played, the character it is about, and the id of the comment under the video that carries the creator's one-image summary (一图流), with that comment's author. No transcript, frame or copy of the picture is kept.
